note: Kiribati, by the Immigration Entry and Visa Exemption Order 2023 (in force 1 September 2023, s. 2): citizens of the countries and regions on its list need no visa (s. 3.1), for a stay of no more than 90 days in any 12 months (s. 3.3); everyone else needs a visa; Taiwanese passports aren't on the list (Kiribati recognised China). Read on 2026-11-03 from the Order as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration publishes it (a scan, read on the page images), which corrected Wikipedia's copy, read before, on the stay (90 days in 12 months, not a month) and on Latvia, Lithuania and Malta, which the list doesn't name and so need a visa.

sources.said: IMMIGRATION ENTRY AND VISA EXEMPTION ORDER 2023 ... 2.Commencement This Order shall enter into force on date on 01 September 2023 3.Exemptions 3.1) The requirement to hold a visa permitting travel to Kiribati is waived for the citizens of countries in the list of Countries and Regions exempted from visa (the list) requirements. ... The maximum period of stay in Kiribati under this exemption must not exceed 90 days in any given 12 month period. ...
